kwoe01.title: Left on Read
kwoe01.caption:
Left on read. Be honest, which one are you?
Re-read it, posted a selfie, went back to work or typed and deleted all night. Drop your number below.

kwoe02.title: The Six-Minute Voice Note
kwoe02.caption:
They sent a six-minute voice note. Now what?
Replay one sigh, burrito up, speed it up or play it for the friends. Pick your number.

kwoe03.title: The Crush Walks In
kwoe03.caption:
Your crush just walked in. What do you do?
Walk over, freeze mid-bite, stare at a poster or fix your hair. We know your number.

kwoe04.title: The 2 a.m. Scroll
kwoe04.caption:
It is 2 a.m. and you are still scrolling.
Endless tabs, old photos, your own profile or an octopus documentary. Which one are you?

kwoe05.title: First Date Nerves
kwoe05.caption:
First date tonight. How are the nerves?
Whole closet on the floor, early with notes, forgot it was today or a mirror pep talk. Your number goes in the comments.

kwoe06.title: "I Like You"
kwoe06.caption:
Someone just said "I like you." Your move?
Snacks, a definition, a picnic plan or a panicked "LIKE like?" Tell us your number.

kwoe07.title: The Ex Liked Your Photo
kwoe07.caption:
Your ex just liked your photo. How do you react?
One raised eyebrow, a new post, too busy to see it or straight to the group chat. Which number?

kwoe08.title: Single at the Wedding
kwoe08.caption:
Single at the wedding? Pick your role.
Dance floor legend, centrepiece fixer, bouquet diver or the one talking about space. Number in the comments, please.

kwoe09.title: They Replied "k"
kwoe09.caption:
They replied with just "k." Breathe.
Make a sandwich, panic-reply, study it closely or stare without blinking. Who are you here?

kwoe10.title: The Friend Who Asks for Advice
kwoe10.caption:
Your friend needs dating advice. What kind of friend are you?
Slideshow, both sides forever, "be weird about it" or your own story. We want your number.

kwoe11.title: The "What Are We?" Talk
kwoe11.caption:
Time for the "what are we" talk. How do you start it?
Loudly, with flashcards, by changing the subject or over dessert. Pick one, out loud.

kwoe12.title: Plans Got Cancelled
kwoe12.caption:
They cancelled the plans. Be honest.
Relieved, booking three more, pyjamas instantly or a photoshoot anyway. Which number are you?

kwoe13.title: The Cute Couple
kwoe13.caption:
Watching a couple be cute. What happens in your head?
Eye-roll then smile, robot questions, outfit ratings or you text your crush. Tell us your number, no judging.

kwoe14.title: Meeting the Friend's New Partner
kwoe14.caption:
Meeting your friend's new partner. Who are you in the room?
The gentle interview, the instant best friend, the quiet watcher or the storyteller. Pick a number.

kwoe15.title: Getting a Compliment
kwoe15.caption:
Someone says "you look great." How do you take it?
"I know," a fast thank-you, saved forever or a polite argument. Leave your number below.

kwoe16.title: The Risky Text
kwoe16.caption:
About to send the risky text. What is your method?
Send and throw the phone, ten drafts, wait for 11:11 or hand it to a friend. Which one?

kwoe17.title: A Sunday With No Plans
kwoe17.caption:
A Sunday with zero plans. How do you spend it?
A legendary nap, a random train, a full clean or calling everyone. Comments: just the number.

kwoe18.title: Missing Your Ex at Midnight
kwoe18.caption:
Midnight, and you miss your ex. What do you do?
Hug the hoodie, write a list, text a friend or stare out the window. Be gentle with yourself. Which is you?

kwoe19.title: The Group Chat Went Quiet
kwoe19.caption:
You texted the group and got silence. Now what?
Send "?", suspect a second chat, not notice at all or send a cat. Say your number.

kwoe20.title: Writing the Dating Bio
kwoe20.caption:
Writing your dating bio. What does yours look like?
One comma for an hour, four words, a riddle or a full résumé. Be honest with us.

kwoe21.title: They Finally Texted Back
kwoe21.caption:
They finally texted back. What happens next?
Wait just as long, scream into a pillow, reply instantly or finish dinner first. Your number, go.

kwoe22.title: Midnight on New Year's Eve
kwoe22.caption:
New Year's Eve, ten seconds left. Where are you?
Leading the countdown, on a rooftop, asleep by ten or hugging everyone. Choose wisely.

kwoe23.title: The Whole Situationship
kwoe23.caption:
One situationship, six moments. Keep count.
First text to "I like you too," then your verdict, with one kind tip for every type.

kwoe24.title: Single for the Holidays
kwoe24.caption:
Single at the holidays? Keep count of your answers.
Six moments, from "seeing anyone?" to midnight, then your verdict and one warm tip.
